metadata.description: Agent skills for running mountOS, self-hosted POSIX-compatible distributed storage.

plugins.name: deploy
plugins.description: Deploy, verify, and operate a self-hosted mountOS storage system. Architecture diagrams, the ordered bring-up, per-stage verification, and the failure modes that report healthy while the system is broken.

plugins.name: integrate
plugins.description: Add mountOS storage under a product that already has customers, users, and an identity provider. Mapping an existing user base, credential-issuing shapes, the reconciliation loop, and picking a data surface per workload.

plugins.name: troubleshoot
plugins.description: Diagnose a mountOS deployment that is failing or behaving wrongly: what evidence to gather in what order, which checks prove nothing, and the failure modes that report healthy while broken.
